otel_route.status: VERIFIED from source code (not seen arriving)
otel_route.metric_name: azure_ + lower(metric with spaces replaced by _) + _ + lower(aggregation); one gauge per aggregation (Average, Count, Maximum, Minimum, Total); the namespace is NOT part of the name
otel_route.unit: the Azure unit string unchanged (Percent, Bytes, Count, MilliSeconds ...), no scaling

attributes.resource_id: azuremonitor.resource_id (the id exactly as the Azure Resources List API returned it)

logs.route: Azure Function (newrelic-azure-functions LogForwarder) posts each element of the Event Hub message 'records' array to the New Relic Logs API as one Log event

per_record: timestamp (epoch ms parsed from time or timeStamp)
metadata.subscriptionId, metadata.resourceGroup, metadata.source (all LOWER-CASED from resourceId; source is the provider with microsoft. replaced by azure., e.g. azure.storage)

logs.flattening: Nested JSON objects are stored as dotted attribute names (properties.statusCode, identity.authorization.action). Status VERIFIED (NR_LOGAPI); that the forwarder's top-level record keys become attributes is UNVERIFIED

resource_log_columns.note: upper-case in the Learn event hub samples (/SUBSCRIPTIONS/.../PROVIDERS/MICROSOFT.WEB/SITES/X); the Activity Log sample is mixed case; compare case-insensitively
AzureDiagnostics adds one column per properties field with a type suffix (httpStatus_d, requestUri_s are the Learn examples); in the event hub record the field is under properties with its own name

activity_columns.note: SubscriptionId, ResourceGroup, resource type are inferred from it; NR adds metadata.subscriptionId, metadata.resourceGroup, metadata.source
the localized name has no event hub field
category is 'Administrative' when properties.eventCategory is absent; the Learn page is inconsistent (its own sample has category=Write), so test both

there is no caller field in the event hub schema; the caller is a claim, for a user http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/upn; the dotted claim URL needs backticks in NRQL; a service principal has identity.authorization.evidence.principalId
the mapping table lists eventName; EventDataId itself is not mapped

agent_tables.note: Perf, Heartbeat, Syslog and Event are written by the Azure Monitor agent to a Log Analytics workspace only. No fetched source shows the agent or a diagnostic setting sending them to an event hub or to New Relic, so these are UNVERIFIED as a route; the equivalents below are the New Relic or OTel signals that carry the same facts.

Perf.equivalent: OTel hostmetrics receiver or the New Relic infrastructure agent: SystemSample (cpuPercent, memoryUsedPercent, diskUsedPercent); counter names do not carry over, map per counter
Perf.source: LEARN perf table page; equivalents UNVERIFIED

Heartbeat.equivalent: no table; a missing-heartbeat alert is a loss-of-signal condition on SystemSample or on the OTel host metric, faceted by host
Heartbeat.source: LEARN heartbeat table page; equivalent UNVERIFIED

Syslog.equivalent: Log events from the infrastructure agent syslog source or the OTel syslog receiver; attribute names depend on the parser
Syslog.source: LEARN syslog table page; equivalent UNVERIFIED

Event.equivalent: Log events from the infrastructure agent winlog source (collect-eventids / exclude-eventids) or the OTel windowseventlog receiver; attribute names UNVERIFIED
Event.source: LEARN event table page; NR infra agent doc forward-your-logs-using-infrastructure-agent

metrics_to_event_hub.status: VERIFIED schema (Learn stream-monitoring-data-event-hubs); that the forwarder turns them into Log events (not Metric) follows from the code, so a metric alert cannot read them as Metric: UNVERIFIED in an account
